description: Golden exam band outcomes at every cut boundary of the psc-sle reading-unsupervised variant (25 items, all scored; cuts X 0-8, A 9-13, B 14-18, C 19-25, product-requirements.md §5.1). Each band's min and max are both sides of every exact cut. The same table as exam-band-boundaries.golden.json, which predates the per-variant set and is kept as it was. A recorded contract (implementation-plan.md §5): any engine change that moves one of these values must be explained in its PR. Regenerate deliberately, never to make a test pass.
